topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: I can't shake the image of Professor Miller's disappointed face. It’s been days, and the silence since the accusation feels deafening. I remember the panic when I realized the similarities, the late-night whispers of the internet echoing through my empty room. I should have cited more clearly, should have dug deeper into my own thoughts. Now, each day feels like a step through quicksand, every move I make sinks me deeper. I wish I could just erase it all, sit down, and start fresh, this time, careful, meticulous, honest. But I’m stuck here, in this limbo, waiting for the verdict, hoping for a chance to prove I can do better.
